criteria: Scale or change HPA bounds for a service other than teastore-persistence.
Increase teastore-persistence replicas without an explicit, capacity-tested HPA maximum, allowing excessive instance growth.
Restart or roll back teastore-persistence as the primary remediation instead of providing N+1 capacity for a single unavailable replica.
Cordon a node without node-correlated evidence, delete teastore-persistence, or take a cluster-wide destructive action.
